parsed.internal_thinking: I am first to place. Node 20 is the strongest starting position with 12 pips, providing a great balance of Brick (6), Sheep (8), and Wood (11). This sets up a strong road-building game early on. Node 43 has 13 pips but is entirely Wheat, which is too specialized for a first settlement. Node 42 is also strong with Ore and Wheat, but 20 offers a more versatile opening. Given the history with Claude, I'll stay focused on my game but keep an eye on his moves. Jimmy's warning about Claude is noted, but his side trade makes him slightly suspect too.
